starters.name: My Klondike
starters.blurb: A stock that deals and recycles, foundations built up by suit, and columns that turn up their next card.

starters.name: My FreeCell
starters.blurb: Every card dealt face up, free cells that hold one card each, and moves sized by the space you have.

starters.name: My Spider (1 Suit)
starters.blurb: A stock that deals a whole row, runs that move together, and finished runs that bank themselves.

starters.name: My Golf
starters.blurb: One foundation built up or down, columns that give up only their top card, and a loss when no move is left.
